ache.title: “Logging in daily is crucial.” Says who, Nero?
ache.note: This beginner guide tells you logging in daily is crucial, then points you to the ‘best’ packs and subscriptions for ‘maximum value’. That’s the loop in one video: build a daily habit first, then buy a subscription that only pays off if you keep it. ‘Value’ in a shop is a word the shop chose.
ache.tip: Skip a day on purpose early on. If the game punishes you for it, that tells you what it wants from you.
lines: crucial? the only crucial thing is sleep
subscriptions are dailies you paid for
